verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents opening real bank accounts per customer through Person, Business and Account Applications, and listing them via the `account` endpoint. That loosely covers per-customer accounts with their own numbers, but nothing in the pack describes virtual accounts, sub-accounts or high-volume issuance. Missing for 10: virtual account numbers for reconciliation, sub-accounts under a master/FBO structure, explicit account/routing number issuance at scale, and independent corroboration.
